name: Mini-Golf
author: Addicting Games
description: Mini-Golf is a cute sports game based on miniature golf. Show up for your aim and shooting skills with this cute shooter game. This online game is designed with your basic golfing obstacles like a puddle of waters, hills, and sandpits. It’s a pretty and sunny day in this online game where you can go out and figure out how to shoot your golf ball. On top of getting your golf ball into the hole, you’ll see little gold stars along with the game that you’ll want to hit along the way for more points. Click on the shopping cart icon, to view other backgrounds and character skins for your ball. Use the stars you collected through the game to unlock each one. Click on the crown icon to view the leaderboards and see where you stand against other mini-golf players. There are several levels of this game for you to play until you beat them all. You only get three tries to get the ball in the hole and then you’ll be sent back to the beginning of the game. Don’t hesitate and use your aiming skills in this cute online mini-golf game.
